mode: read-only RPC; all transaction signing and submission occurred outside this script
snapshotScope: historical end-of-block state; not current governance status
verificationScope: Governance transactions, events, approvals, prior-state and post-state validated.
limitations: Three local test-wallet accounts are not independent real institutions. Expected business intent is checked only for fields supplied in expected.json. Snapshots are end-of-block state and reject later institution revisions.
